title: Wrath
extract:
Wrath is  Orion's signature Heavy Scythe. The weapon gains increased Critical Chance upon hitting enemies with a Slam Attack.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Slam attacks grant the Gravitic Slash buff, increasing Critical Chance by 15% (additive to mods such as  True Steel) per enemy enemy hit, stacking up to 10 times for 150% additional Critical Chance. Lasts 10 seconds and can be refreshed.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
High crit chance (30.00%)
Above average total damage (220)
High damage × attack speed (343.2)
Very high block angle (65°)
Very high attack speed (1.200x animation speed)
High attack range (2.80 m)
Above average crit multiplier (2.00x)
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
High crit chance (30.00%)
Above average total damage (440)
Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
Very high block angle (65°)
Above average damage × attack speed (572)
High attack range (2.80 m)

High crit chance (30.00%)
Above average total damage (660)
Above average attack speed (1.000x animation speed)
Very high block angle (65°)
Above average damage × attack speed (858)
High attack range (2.80 m)

Comparisons:

 Wrath (Normal Attack), compared to  Pride (Normal Attack):
Lower base damage (220.00 vs. 250.00)
Lower  Puncture damage ( 44 vs.  125)
Higher  Slash damage ( 176 vs.  125)
Lower total damage (220 vs. 250)
Higher base critical chance (30.00% vs. 15.00%)
Lower base status chance (15.00% vs. 35.00%)

Acquisition
Wrath's main and component blueprints can be obtained from Scoria's Angel, Uranus Proxima, as well as a  Pride Blade from The Kuva Wytch. Access requires completion of Jade Shadows: Constellations.
Alternatively Wrath and the Pride Blade's blueprints can be purchased from Pontis Tower with  Crimson Talent and  Emerald Talent, awarded from Scoria's Angel and The Kuva Wytch respectively in quantities of 12-16 (18-22 on The Steel Path) from mission completion plus shooting down targets from the Ramsled/Orowyrm minigame. Each component requires 45 and the main blueprint requires 90, totaling 180  Crimson Talent and 45  Emerald Talent for the whole set.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.

Trivia
 Pride and Wrath share the exact same design, with the only difference being which end is pointing upwards (in Wrath's case, the red end associated with Orion).
